G2201.strongs: a couple, i.e. a team (of oxen yoked together) or brace (of birds tied together)

G2202.root: feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as [[w:G2218]]

G2203.strongs: in the oblique cases there is used instead of it a (probably cognate) name, which is otherwise obsolete; Zeus or Dis (among the Latins, Jupiter or Jove), the supreme deity of the Greeks
senses: Ζεύς genitive, Διός, dative, Διΐ, accusative, Δία (Δίαν, D, al.), Zeus (Lat. Jupiter): [[r:ACT.14.12|Act 14:12-13.]]† (AS)

G2204.strongs: to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e. (figuratively) be fervid (earnest)
senses: ζέω to boil, be hot; metaphorically, of anger, love, zeal: ptcp., fervent: τ. πνεύματι, [[r:ACT.18.25|Act 18:25]], [[r:ROM.12.11|Rom 12:11]].† (AS)

G2205.forms: ζῆλος, -ου, ὁ and in late Gk., also -εος, τό ([[r:2CO.9.2|2Co 9:2]], [[r:PHP.3.6|Php 3:6]])
G2205.strongs: properly, heat, i.e. (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband (figuratively, of God), or an enemy, malice)
G2205.kjv: emulation, envy(-ing), fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal
senses: zeal: [[r:2CO.7.11|2Co 7:11 9:2]]; κατά ζῆλος, [[r:PHP.3.6|Php 3:6]]; with genitive obj., [[r:JHN.2.17|Jhn 2:17]] (LXX), [[r:ROM.10.2|Rom 10:2]]; before ὑπέρ, [[r:2CO.7.7|2Co 7:7]]; with genitive subj., θεοῦ, [[r:2CO.11.2|2Co 11:2]]; πυρός, [[r:HEB.10.27|Heb 10:27]] (cf. [[r:ISA.26.11|Isa 26:11]], [[r:WIS.5.18|Wis 5:18]], and cf. Westc., in l).

G2206.strongs: to have warmth of feeling for or against
G2206.kjv: affect, covet (earnestly), (have) desire, (move with) envy, be jealous over, (be) zealous(-ly affect)
senses: to burn with envy or jealousy, to be jealousy: absol., [[r:ACT.7.9|Act 7:9 17:5]], [[r:1CO.13.4|1Co 13:4]], [[r:JAS.4.2|Jas 4:2]] (R, mg., cf. Mayor, in l).

to seek or desire eagerly: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.12.31|1Co 12:31 14:1 14:39]] (cf. [[r:SIR.50.18|Sir 50:18]], [[r:WIS.1.12|Wis 1:12]]); with accusative of person(s), [[r:2CO.11.2|2Co 11:2]], [[r:GAL.4.17|Gal 4:17]]; pass., [[r:GAL.4.18|Gal 4:18.]]† (AS)
in cl. an emulator, zealous admirer (Plat., al.).
absol., as in OT, ll. with;

with genitive obj.: (zealous to acquire or to defend), [[r:1CO.14.12|1Co 14:12]], [[r:TIT.2.14|Tit 2:14]], [[r:1PE.3.13|1Pe 3:13]]; τ. νόμου (2Mac, l.with), [[r:ACT.21.20|Act 21:20]]; παραδόσεων, [[r:GAL.1.14|Gal 1:14]]; with genitive of person(s), θεοῦ, [[r:ACT.22.3|Act 22:3.]]
In FlJ, NT, a Zealot, member of the Jewish party so called: as surname of the Apostle Simon, [[r:LUK.6.15|Luk 6:15]], [[r:ACT.1.13|Act 1:13]].† (AS)

G2209.root: probably akin to the base of [[w:G1150]] (through the idea of violence)

G2210.strongs: to injure, i.e. (reflexively or passively) to experience detriment
G2210.kjv: be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss
senses: ζημόω, -ῶ (ζημία), to damage. Pass., to suffer loss, forfeit, lose: absol., [[r:1CO.3.15|1Co 3:15]]; before ἐν, [[r:2CO.7.9|2Co 7:9]]; with accusative of thing(s) (see B1., § 34, 6), τ. ψυχήν, [[r:MAT.16.26|Mat 16:26]], [[r:MRK.8.36|Mrk 8:36]]; ἑαυτόν, [[r:LUK.9.25|Luk 9:25]]; τ. πάντα, [[r:PHP.3.8|Php 3:8.]]† (AS)

G2211.root: probably contracted from a poetic form of [[w:G2203]] and [[w:G1435]]

G2212.strongs: to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life)
G2212.kjv: be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means)
senses: to seek, seek for: [[r:MAT.7.7|Mat 7:7]], 8 [[r:LUK.11.9|Luk 11:9]], 10; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.1.37|Mrk 1:37]], [[r:LUK.2.48|Luk 2:48]], [[r:JHN.6.24|Jhn 6:24]], al.; id. before ἐν, [[r:ACT.9.11|Act 9:11]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.13.45|Mat 13:45]], [[r:LUK.19.10|Luk 19:10]]; before ἐν, [[r:LUK.13.6|Luk 13:6]], 7; ψυχήν, of plotting against one's life ( [[r:EXO.4.19|Exo 4:19]], al.), [[r:MAT.2.20|Mat 2:20]], [[r:ROM.11.3|Rom 11:3]]" (LXX). Metaphorical, to seek by thinking, search after, inquire into: [[r:MRK.11.18|Mrk 11:18]], [[r:LUK.12.28|Luk 12:28]], Jhn 16:19; τ. θεόν, [[r:ACT.17.27|Act 17:27.]]

to seek or strive after, desire: [[r:MAT.12.46|Mat 12:46]], [[r:MRK.12.12|Mrk 12:12]], [[r:LUK.9.9|Luk 9:9]], [[r:JHN.5.18|Jhn 5:18]], [[r:ROM.10.3|Rom 10:3]], al.; τ. θάνατον, [[r:REV.9.6|Rev 9:6]]; τ. βασιλείαν τ. θεοῦ, [[r:MAT.6.33|Mat 6:33]] (Dalman, Words, 121f.); τὰ ἄνω, [[r:COL.3.1|Col 3:1]]; εἰρήνην, [[r:1PE.3.11|1Pe 3:11]] (LXX).

to require, demand: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MRK.8.12|Mrk 8:12]], [[r:LUK.11.29|Luk 11:29]], [[r:1CO.1.22|1Co 1:22]], [[r:2CO.13.3|2Co 13:3]]; before παρά, [[r:MRK.8.11|Mrk 8:11]], al.; ἵνα, [[r:1CO.4.2|1Co 4:2]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-ζητέω). (AS)

G2213.strongs: a search (properly concretely), i.e. (in words) a debate

G2214.strongs: a searching (properly, the act), i.e. a dispute or its theme

G2218.strongs: a coupling, i.e. (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales)
senses: a yoke; metaphorically, of bondage or submission to authority: [[r:MAT.11.29|Mat 11:29-30]], [[r:ACT.15.10|Act 15:10]], [[r:GAL.5.1|Gal 5:1]], [[r:1TI.6.1|1Ti 6:1]].

leaven: [[r:MAT.13.33|Mat 13:33]], [[r:LUK.13.21|Luk 13:21]]; τ. ἄρτου, [[r:MAT.16.12|Mat 16:12.]] Metaphorical, of a moral influence or tendency, always, exc. in the Parable of the Leaven ([[r:MAT.13.33|Mat 13:33]], [[r:LUK.13.21|Luk 13:21]]), for evil: [[r:1CO.5.6|1Co 5:6-8]], [[r:GAL.5.9|Gal 5:9]]; ζ. τ. Φαρισαίων, [[r:MAT.16.6|Mat 16:6, 11]], [[r:MRK.8.16|Mrk 8:16]], [[r:LUK.12.1|Luk 12:1]] (Cremer, 723).† (AS)

G2221.strongs: to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e. (figuratively) to capture or ensnare
senses: (ζωός, alive, + ἀγρεύω) to catch alive, take captive: metaphorically, [[r:LUK.5.10|Luk 5:10]]; pass., [[r:2TI.2.26|2Ti 2:26]] (on the meaning and construction, see Ellic., CGT, in l).† (AS)
life (in Hom., Hdt., = βίος, which see; later, existence, vita quâ vivimus, as distinct from βίος, vita quam vivimus; opposite to θάνατος);

of natural life: [[r:LUK.16.25|Luk 16:25]], [[r:ACT.8.33|Act 8:33]], [[r:1CO.15.19|1Co 15:19]], [[r:1TI.4.8|1Ti 4:8]], [[r:HEB.7.3|Heb 7:3]], [[r:JAS.4.14|Jas 4:14]]; πνεῦμα ζωῆς, [[r:REV.11.11|Rev 11:11]]; ψυχὴ ζωῆς ( [[r:GEN.1.30|Gen 1:30]]), [[r:REV.16.3|Rev 16:3]]; of the life of one risen from the dead, [[r:ROM.5.10|Rom 5:10]], [[r:HEB.7.16|Heb 7:16]].

Of the life of the kingdom of God, the present life of grace and the life of glory which is to follow (Dalman, Words, 156ff.; Westc, Epp. Jo., 214ff.; Cremer, 272ff.): [[r:JHN.6.51|Jhn 6:51, 53]] [[r:ROM.7.10|Rom 7:10 8:6, 10]] [[r:PHP.2.16|Php 2:16]], [[r:COL.3.4|Col 3:4]], [[r:2PE.1.3|2Pe 1:3]]; αἰώνος (reff. supr.; DCG, i, 538a, ii, 30f.), [[r:JHN.4.36|Jhn 4:36 12:50 17:3]], [[r:1JN.1.2|1Jn 1:2]], al.; τ. φῶς τῆς ζ., [[r:JHN.8.12|Jhn 8:12]]; ὁ Λόγος τ. ζ., [[r:1JN.1.1|1Jn 1:1]]; ὁ ἄρτος τ. ζ., [[r:JHN.6.35|Jo 6:35, 48]]; δικαίωσις ζωῆς, [[r:ROM.5.18|Rom 5:18]]; μετάνοια εἰς ζ., [[r:ACT.11.18|Act 11:18]]; ἐν αὐτῷ ζ. ἦν, [[r:JHN.1.4|Jhn 1:4]]; ζ. ἡ ἐν. senses: ζώννυμι and ζωννύω to gird: with accusative of person(s), [[r:JHN.21.18|Jhn 21:18.]] Mid., to gird oneself: [[r:ACT.12.8|Act 12:8]] (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, περι-, ὑπο-ζώννυμι).† (AS)

G2225.strongs: to engender alive, i.e. (by analogy) to rescue (passively, be saved) from death
senses: in cl., to engender, produce alive, endue with life.
In LXX. and NT, to preserve alive (DCG, ii, 606; Cremer, 274): [[r:LUK.17.33|Luk 17:33]], [[r:ACT.7.19|Act 7:19]], [[r:1TI.6.13|1Ti 6:13]] (EV, quickeneth; R, mg., preserveth).† (AS)

senses: (ζωός, alive), a living creature, an animal: [[r:REV.4.6|Rev 4:6-9 5:6]] ff. [[r:REV.6.1|Rev 6:1]] ff. [[r:REV.7.11|Rev 7:11 14:3 15:7 19:4]]; ζῴων τ. αἷμα, [[r:HEB.13.11|Heb 13:11]]; ἄλογα ζ., [[r:2PE.2.12|2Pe 2:12]], Ju 10.† SYN.: θηρίον, in which the brutal, bestial element is emphasized, and which is never used of sacrificial animals. On the other hand, ζ. is the more comprehensive, as expressing the vital element common to the whole anima] creation (see Tr., Syn., LXXxi; Cremer, 274). (AS)
in cl. (= ζωογονέω), to produce alive.

senses: to rule, be leader: present ptcp., ἡγούενος, a ruler, leader (MM, Exp., xiv), [[r:MAT.2.6|Mat 2:6]] (LXX), [[r:LUK.22.26|Luk 22:26]], [[r:ACT.7.10|Act 7:10 14:12 15:22]], [[r:HEB.13.7|Heb 13:7, 17 13:24]].

to suppose, believe, consider, think (Hdt., Soph., al.; of. G2234.root: adverb from a derivative of the base of [[w:G2237]]

G2238.root: neuter of the compound of the same as [[w:G2234]] and [[w:G3744]]

G2240.strongs: to arrive, i.e. be present (literally or figuratively)
senses: ἥκω pf. with present meaning (hence imperfect = plpf.), to have come, be present: [[r:MAT.24.50|Mat 24:50]], [[r:MRK.8.3|Mrk 8:3]] (late pf., ἧκα, see Swete, in l; WH, App., 169), [[r:LUK.12.46|Luk 12:46 15:27]], [[r:JHN.8.42|Jhn 8:42]], [[r:HEB.10.7|Heb 10:7, 9 10:37]], I [[r:JHN.5.20|Jn 5:20]], [[r:REV.2.25|Rev 2:25 3:3, 9 15:4]]; before ἀπό, with genitive loc., [[r:MAT.8.11|Mat 8:11]], [[r:LUK.13.29|Luk 13:29]]; ἐκ, [[r:ROM.11.26|Rom 11:26]]; id. before εἰς, [[r:JHN.4.47|Jhn 4:47]]; μακρόθεν, [[r:MRK.8.3|Mrk 8:3]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:REV.3.3|Rev 3:3.]] Metaphorical, of discipleship: [[r:JHN.6.37|Jhn 6:37]]; of time and events: absol., [[r:MAT.24.14|Mat 24:14]], [[r:JHN.2.4|Jhn 2:4]], [[r:2PE.3.10|2Pe 3:10]], [[r:REV.18.8|Rev 18:8]]; before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.23.36|Mat 23:36]], [[r:LUK.19.43|Luk 19:43]] (cf. ἀν-, καθ-ήκω).† (AS)

Ἡλεί (Rec. Ἡλί; RV, Ἡλί), ὁ, indecl., Heli, Joseph's father: [[r:LUK.3.23|Luk 3:23.]]† (AS)
(ἧλιξ, of the same age, mature), always of age or maturity; "a stage of growth whether measured by age or stature";

stature: [[r:LUK.19.3|Luk 19:3]] ([[r:MAT.6.27|Mat 6:27]], [[r:LUK.12.25|Luk 12:25]], AV, R, txt.; but the prevailing usage in LXX and π. favours the former meaning in these doubtful passages; cf., Ellic., ICC, AR, on Eph, l.with; Milligan, NTD, 74 f., and esp., MM, Exp., xv; e contra, Field, Notes, 6).† (AS)

1. as Substantive Verb, to be, to exist , οὐκ ἔσθ᾽ οὗτος ἀνήρ, οὐδ᾽ ἔσσεται (Odyssey by Homer); τεθνηῶτος, μηδ᾽ ἔτ᾽ ἐόντος (Odyssey by Homer); οὐκέτ᾽ ἔστι he is no more , (Euripides); θεοὶ αἰὲν ἐόντες (Iliad by Homer); ἐσσόμενοι posterity, (Iliad by Homer); ζώντων καὶ ὄντων Ἀθηναίων (Demosthenes Orator):—;so of cities, etc., ὄλωλεν, οὐδ᾽ ἔτ᾽ ἔστι Τροία (compare Troja fuit) , (Euripides) 2. of things, to be, exist , εἰ ἔστιν ἀληθέως (Herdotus Historicus); ἕως ἂν ὁ πόλεμος ἦι so long as it last , (Thucydides) 3. to be , opposite to appearing to be , as esse to videri , τὸν ἐόντα λόγον the true story, (Herdotus Historicus); τὰ ὄντα ἀπαγγέλλειν (Thucydides); τῶι ὄντι, Lat. revera, in reality, in fact, (Plato Philosophus) 4. followed by the Relative, οὐκ ἔστιν ὅς, no one , (Iliad by Homer), etc.; εἰσὶν οἵ, Lat. sunt qui, (Thucydides), etc.; ἐστὶν ἅ some things , (Thucydides); also ἔστιν οἵ, for εἰσὶν οἵ, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.:—;so withrelat. Particles, ἔστιν ἔνθα, Lat. est ubi, (Xenophon Historicus), etc.; ἔστιν ὅπη, ἔσθ᾽ ὅπου, somewhere , or somehow , (Plato Philosophus), etc.; ἔστιν ὅπως in some manner , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.; ἔστιν ὅτε, ἔσθ᾽ ὅτε, sometimes , (Sophocles Tragicus), etc. 5. ἔστι impersonal, with infinitive, like πάρεστι, it is possible , (Homer), attic 6. to be , Copula connecting predicate with subject, both being in the same case, (Homer), etc. 7. sometimes εἶναι with Part. represents finite Verb, ἦν τεθνηκώς, for ἐτεθνήκει, (Aeschulus Tragicus); πεφυκός ἐστι = πέφυκε, (Aristophanes Comicus) 8. the Inf. is redundant in some phrases, ἑκὼν εἶναι (see. ἑκών II); τὸ ἐπ᾽ ἐκείνοις εἶναι quantum in illis esset , (Thucydides); τὸ σύμπαν εἶναι (Herdotus Historicus); τὸ νῦν εἶναι (Plato Philosophus), etc. (ML)
